name: Russia–Ukraine
value: 162 drones overnight 28 Nov; 7 killed in Nizhyn
summary: Russia launched 162 drones overnight to 28 Nov; the toll from a 27 Nov strike in Nizhyn rose to seven killed
state: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia launched 162 drones overnight to 28 Nov, 141 of them intercepted; Russian attacks killed 10 and injured 55 over the past day, according to regional officials (Kyiv Independent). The State Emergency Service said on 28 Nov that a strike on a business in Nizhyn on 27 Nov killed seven people (Kyiv Post). Drones hit energy infrastructure in Mykolaiv region on 27 Nov (LB.ua). Sustained mass strikes on energy keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice against all travel to Ukraine. Strikes on energy infrastructure can affect European power and gas markets.
rubric_hit: Sustained mass-casualty strikes on energy = Alert
